summary: Bonner County cupola-cabin lookout first used in 1921, abandoned by 1952 and later collapsed under snow; listed as gone, with no source describing the site today.

facts.status_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts says it collapsed under heavy snow; the FFLA list marks it gone; no source describes what remains

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts files the site as hike-in

events.note: First used with a camp lookout
Fire warden's report quoted by Forest Lookouts: two deputy wardens, one lookout and one smoke chaser in the lookout cabin
Collapsed under heavy snow. firelookout.com gives 1999 with a question mark; Idaho Fire Lookouts places it in the 1990s

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives 1999 but marks the year with a question mark; Idaho Fire Lookouts says the 1990s. The story reports both and does not choose one.

notes_for_editor: Record kind 'ground' matches the FFLA 'Ground' label and the cupola cabin. Elevation 6,210 ft is from Idaho Fire Lookouts; elevation is not a facts key so it is only in the story. No new photos: the image URLs on these pages are not in the text we read. Forest Lookouts quotes the 1927 report as the 'Caribou Peak lookout' and places the cabin in NW 1/4 of section 30, T59N R2W; not used. The 'staffing as_of 1952' date is the abandonment year, not an end-of-staffing date from a source.
